04 / Plan the delivery

Selling equipment shouldn’t always mean storing it.

Ask about shipping directly to your customer.

Taking delivery at your roastery just to arrange another shipment adds handling and coordination.

Drop-shipping options for reseller orders.

Pro Coffee Partners offers drop shipping for resellers. Talk with the team about whether your account, selected equipment and customer’s delivery location qualify.

Confirm freight costs, receiving requirements and lead times before you quote. That way, the delivery plan is part of the equipment conversation—not an afterthought.

An option to supply equipment without holding that order at your roastery.

Confirm eligibility and shipping arrangements for each order. Blind shipping and consolidated delivery are not assumed.

05 / Support the relationship after the sale

Their espresso machine stops. Your phone rings.

Have somewhere to turn when equipment questions get technical.

When a café needs a part or help with a machine, you need more than another supplier’s sales catalog.

Parts sourcing, technical resources and an experienced team.

Bring the machine model, symptoms and location. Ask the team about parts availability, technical guidance and next steps for the equipment your customer uses.

Pro Coffee Partners also describes a technician network across the country. Ask what service options are available for your customer’s location and machine.

Help your café customer find a path forward—even when you don’t have the answer yourself.

Confirm parts lead times and service scope. Remote guidance, warranty, on-site labor and installation are different services. Local technician availability and repair or delivery deadlines are not guaranteed.

Before you get started

Useful details for roasters.

Do I need to be an established equipment reseller?

Tell the team how you currently support your café accounts and whether you already sell equipment. They will review your business and program fit; this page does not guarantee eligibility or approval.

Can I discuss a project before applying?

Yes. Use the scheduling link to discuss equipment needs and how the wholesale program could fit your business.

Can orders ship to my café customer?

Drop-shipping options are available for resellers. Confirm account and product eligibility, delivery location, freight costs and receiving requirements with the team before quoting.

What happens if a customer needs service?

Contact the team with the machine model, symptoms and location to discuss available guidance, parts and service options. Warranty coverage, on-site labor, installation and travel are separate considerations; confirm what applies.
